claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA. This will bring investment and good jobs
claims.statement: The new GBR home in Derby will bring investment and good jobs.

claims.quote: estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new HQ will give an estimated £151 million boost to the region's economy.

claims.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
claims.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years since public ownership began to be delivered.
Construction of the Becketwell headquarters is expected to be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
claims.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.

claims.quote: creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: The biggest shake-up to our railways in a generation is underway.
claims.statement: The biggest shake-up to the railways in a generation is underway.

claims.quote: I’m particularly pleased about the 600 apprenticeship places.
claims.statement: The 600 apprenticeship places are a welcome benefit for young people in the East Midlands.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby.

facts.quote: Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre
facts.statement: The GBR headquarters site is Becketwell, a brownfield site in Derby city centre.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The Derby site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

facts.quote: I’m delighted Becketwell will become GBR’s new home
facts.statement: Heidi Alexander said she was delighted Becketwell will become GBR's new home.
Andy Burnham, Prime Minister, gave a statement on the GBR headquarters announcement.

facts.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
facts.statement: Claire Ward, Mayor of the East Midlands, welcomed the announcement as fantastic news for Derby.
